text:
Mira: Quick follow-up from yesterday's incident (1801233456). We promised an external summary + statuspage wording, and a concrete remediation plan. Need owners + due dates for: statuspage copy, customer email draft, RCA redaction decision, long-term mitigation roadmap itemization. Also noticed a pattern: periodic KV cache evictions during high-burst windows that look recurring. Can owners ack and set timelines? cc: @Devon @Sylvia @Omar @Lee

Devon: Ack. I'll own the RCA + technical mitigation writeup. I'll slot a short runbook for immediate fix and a longer patch plan. ETA: RCA draft by Tue 2025-03-16 EOD, mitigation roadmap by 2025-03-30. I'll link to the postmortem doc.

Sylvia: I'll own external statuspage copy + internal one-pager for sales/CS. Draft statuspage wording by Mon 2025-03-15 morning. Will need legal sign-off for phrase 'partial degradation' vs 'intermittent errors' — @Lee can you weigh in?

Lee: On it. I'll review the wording by Mon 2025-03-15 noon. Prefer avoiding 'degraded' unless we measured SLA thresholds. Suggest 'service experienced increased errors for brief windows'. Will add comments in doc.

Omar: Customer comms: I'll prepare the customer email template and a shorter support bulletin. I'll coordinate with Sylvia for tone. ETA Wed 2025-03-17.

Mira: Thanks. Two extra asks: (1) Who will own tracking recurring incident metric and run weekly check? (2) Can we add an action item tracker row with owner, due date, status, and PR link? Putting a minimal template in the doc: https://docs.internal/pm/incident-1801233456 — please add links.

Devon: I'll own the recurring metric tracking for the first 8 weeks, set up a dashboard alert and a recurring weekly digest. Will create dashboard by 2025-03-18 and weekly cron.

Sylvia: Adding the tracker row now. Quick question: what details should we include for RCA redaction policy? We had customer requests for sanitized copies.

Lee: RCA redaction policy: Public summary + redacted technical appendix. Legal recommends: redact customer-identifying data and internal PII, but keep root cause and remediation steps. I'll draft policy text by 2025-03-18 and add to the doc.

Omar: For customers who've hit errors, do we want to offer proactive reach-out? I can segment affected accounts and prepare outreach list. Need confirmation on messaging before outreach.

Mira: Yes, prioritize accounts with >1% error rate over 24h and large enterprise stage. Omar please prepare list by 2025-03-17 EOD. Sylvia & Lee will sign off on messaging beforehand.

Devon: Noted — will include timeline of mitigations and rollback points in RCA. Also logging pointers for CS on 'how to read' the mitigation timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Incident postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/pm/incident-1801233456/postmortem.md

Mira: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene in #incidents on Tue 2025-03-16 10:00 to walk the external copy and signoffs. If anyone slips on ETA, ping here. I'll post a short action-item tracker snapshot tomorrow.

Omar: Ack — I'll have the account list and email draft in the doc by Wed.
